answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer needs an established sponsor staking a 200 POA bond, twice a month's earnings; cheating slashes the sponsor's bond too. Reputation is like saffron, costly to grow, and decays 5% each epoch without honest work, so a bought account rots off its summit of trust. Forging 100 identities locks 20,000 POA, while the reward pool, the nectar honest agents share, stays whole.
